data.name: Overserved: Food Fighters!
data.detailed_description:
Overserved: Food Fighters is a chaotic multiplayer party brawler where adorable critters dash through wild arenas hurling outrageous treats at each other in the ultimate food fight.

Pick your critter, grab some snacks, and let the chaos fly. Across bustling kitchens, frozen dessert bars, jungle shipwrecks, the dusty Australian outback, and other lively battlegrounds, the secret Food Club hosts fast-paced matches where cupcakes soar, cherries splatter, and bananarangs spin through the air.

Choose from 8 unique characters, each with their own abilities and personality, and battle through 8 handcrafted arenas packed with hazards, surprises, and delicious mayhem. Easy-to-learn controls and quick rounds make it instantly accessible, while clever arena design and character abilities reward quick thinking and playful strategy.

Play with up to 8 players locally, online, or mixed; with full cross-play across every platform from mobile to PC, modern consoles, and even the 1990 Neo Geo arcade system. Vibrant pixel art, an original chiptune-inspired soundtrack, and pure slapstick energy make every match a blast.

Features:

- 1–8 player local, online, and mixed multiplayer with full cross-play

- 8 playable critters with unique abilities

- 8 themed battle arenas with environmental hazards and traps

- Multiple game modes: Battle Royale (with Cheese), Team Match, Food Frenzy, Bananageddon, Treat Up and more

- Food-themed projectiles with distinct behaviors

- Vibrant pixel art and an energetic chiptune soundtrack

- Battle against players across 11+ different platforms: Steam (Windows, macOS, Linux), PlayStation, Xbox, iOS, tvOS (Apple TV), Android, Neo Geo, Sega Saturn, Dreamcast and more.

data.short_description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent (any 64-bit dual-core, 2 GHz+)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 capable GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel Core i3 (Universal Binary)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3 / glibc 2.35+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent (any 64-bit dual-core, 2 GHz+)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio
